name: Exa Search
description: Neural and keyword web search via the Exa API (https://exa.ai), exposed as two declarative HTTP tools: search and find-similar. Requires a BYOK Exa API key.

config.description: Neural and keyword web search via the Exa API. Returns relevant web pages with titles, URLs, published dates, and full page text. Requires RYU_EXA_API_KEY.

query.description: The search query. Supports natural-language and keyword queries.

use_autoprompt.description: Let Exa rephrase the query for better neural search results (default true).

config.description: Web search through Exa's PUBLIC MCP endpoint, which needs no API key. Rate-limited free tier, intended as the zero-setup fallback when RYU_EXA_API_KEY is unset; add a key to use the higher-limit exa__search instead. Speaks JSON-RPC: the caller supplies the whole `tools/call` envelope, and the reply is a text/event-stream frame, so the capability adapter parses it rather than a response map.

Accept.description: Sent as the Accept header. The endpoint 406s unless it names BOTH application/json and text/event-stream.

params.description: `{name, arguments}` naming the Exa MCP tool to call and its arguments.

config.description: Find pages similar to a given URL using Exa's neural search. Requires RYU_EXA_API_KEY.

url.description: URL to find similar pages for.

num_results.description: Number of similar results to return (default 10).

fields.label: Exa API key
fields.description: Create a key at https://dashboard.exa.ai/api-keys and paste it here. Stored encrypted on this node and never shown again — re-paste to change it. Without a key the Exa tools stay installed but return nothing, so `web.search` falls back to whichever other provider you select.
